home.title: Seer — SEO and localisation in one build
home.description: Seer validates locale JSON structure and generates canonical URLs, hreflang, JSON-LD, robots.txt, sitemaps, and framework-neutral content before deploy.

home.heading: SEO and localisation—from 50 manual steps to one build.
home.summary: Author locale JSON. Seer validates every locale file's structure and generates the content and search files your static or server-rendered site needs. No Seer runtime ships to the browser.
home.claim_note: The 50-step shorthand models ten repeated checks across five locales; your checklist will vary.
home.start_copy: Install Seer, then run it before your site build.
home.author_copy: Store shared data once and translated copy in one file per locale.
home.validate_copy: Seer fails on missing keys, unsafe paths, malformed metadata, and inconsistent locale structure.
home.ship_copy: Consume locale JSON and emit canonical URLs, hreflang, JSON-LD, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml.
home.api_copy: Load the project once at build or start time, then map neutral metadata through your framework's native head API.
home.boundary_copy: Seer does not translate copy, invent schema, promise rankings, or add a browser localisation runtime.
